digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler test suite, Jira Data Center backend
propositions: DC backend has no value-pinning characterization tests; only shape assertions exist in test_backend_contract.py, leaving DC's mappings and boundaries untested at the value level while Cloud's were hardened by production incidents

test_backend_characterization.py pins Cloud backend only via hard-bound _backend() fixture, leaving _map_local_to_dc_fields (DC create-path mapper distinct from Cloud's outbound_fields.py) completely uncovered
OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote shared body is exercised only through AdfCodec in test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py, never through WikiTextCodec, leaving DC composition regressions undetected

DC's _backend() seam with FakeTransport cannot reach real probe classifier branches; probe pins must call classify_probe_response directly or construct JiraDataCenterTransport over a stub JIRA client to cover all four branches

DC's DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES is byte-identical to Cloud's RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES, making a default-only probe pin vacuous; discriminator assertion requires passing custom resolved_statuses set to prove DC binds its own config

Every value pin (priority map, status map, sanitizer boundaries, identity label form, truncation suffix, field mappers, probe branches, resolved statuses) must be mutation-checked by perturbing the value and confirming only that pin fails
